nativeUV: Original UVMap unchanged; no added UV layer in retained B.

sourceUVChart.method: Connected geometry edges only if their two source-UV endpoints also match. Source cheek seed selects one continuous external head photo chart; separate mouth/body/lining islands are excluded.

correspondence.definition: Native cage vertex counts, not area coverage or an accuracy percentage. Guarded regions use the explicit reference base reflectance; chart matching is approximate across different source geometry.

staticSkinAppearance.scope: Static head skin appearance only, not anatomy,eyes,hair,dynamics or a complete-character total.
staticSkinAppearance.improvement: Pigment/lip/nose color variation and controlled roughness/subsurface response replace the uniform gray clay, with the corrected UV-band defects removed.
deductions: Different-source pigment correspondence and fallback regions remain visible around eyes/ears/neck.
Photographic baked shading is not a measured albedo map.
Procedural microbump is not measured pore shape.
Skin remains soft/waxy in closeup; no qualified skin movement or engine bake/performance.

contactEvidence.basis: All actual displayed body/optical evaluated vertex+triangle SHA signatures match exact source. No new geometry or displacement, so the existing neutral scope remains valid.

engineStatus: Not baked/exported/integrated or benchmarked. Named coordinate/roughness fields and procedural bump require an engine-compatible bake or shader implementation.
rebuild: Blender5.2.2,--disable-autoexec,--threads4. Run inspect-female-next-r0032-skin-registration.py with pinned r23 and r30 sources, then build-female-next-r0032-registered-skin.py -- --chart-uv, then verify-female-next-r0032-registered-skin.py -- --chart-uv. Existing local CC0 pigment and calibration are inputs; no download/add-on required.
limitations: Approximate facial registration from a different subject/base, no exact skin capture.
Body outside registered head uses reference base reflectance only; no full body pigment detail claim.
Photographic source may contain baked shading, not a measured albedo scan.
Procedural microbump and coordinate-field sampling need engine-compatible baking.
No geometry/motion/contact/runtime changes or full-character acceptance.
